headline: Frontlines flare in six sectors as casualties climb
war_summary: On day 679 of War 140 the map remains sharply split: Colonials control most western and central hexes while Wardens hold a northern arc and several interior sectors. The heaviest fighting persists in Callahans Passage, where combined casualties exceed 300,000, though the hourly loss rate has cooled sharply. Dead Lands and Weathered Expanse each recorded tens of thousands of new casualties in the past 24 hours, with Weathered Expanse adding roughly 8,300 Colonial and 9,000 Warden losses. Enlistment activity is rising in the most contested zones — Weathered Expanse (about 21 per hour), Kuura Strand (16 per hour), Marban Hollow (32 per hour) and Nevish Line (27 per hour) — signalling fresh troop influx. Strategic‑base ownership is shifting rapidly in six regions: Weathered Expanse (61 base events, five hotly contested bases), Kuura Strand (35 events, Faden Point and Menneen leading), Marban Hollow (34 events, Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall), Nevish Line (20 events, Tomb Father and Blackcoat Way), Pari Peak (17 events, Kohina Base and Pariah) and Olavis Wake (16 events, Koskinla and Ilmari Bridge). Elsewhere the front is largely static, with no captures reported in the last day.
